items.generated_zh: 他们摘麦穗，用手搓揉吃里面过麦粒。
items.generated_en: They pick the wheat ears and rub them by hand to eat the grains inside.
"The Son of Man is Lord of the Sabbath."

items.generated_zh: 因为当人们因人子恨你们、排斥着你们、辱骂你们、又恶言骂你们时，你们有福了。
items.generated_en: Blessed are you when people hate you, exclude you, insult you, and reject you because of the Son of Man.

items.generated_zh: 敌过人爱你们个的，对恨你们的人行善。
items.generated_en: Love those who love you, and do good to those who hate you.

items.generated_zh: 在去除眼中的刺之前，我们必须像主一样，低下和谅意。
items.generated_en: Before removing the speck from someone else's eye, we must humble ourselves and show understanding like the Lord.
